title: orchis cordigera f. rivularis
intro: Orchis cordigera f. rivularis, commonly known as Himalayan orchid or Cobra orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid plant found in the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Orchis cordigera f. rivularis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
